scope: 39 selected repositories: 23 public source projects and 16 private projects described only through the already-public atlas; all upstream forks and portal excluded.
evidence_boundary: Public projects use current public README evidence. Private projects use only published atlas descriptions pinned to the public portfolio baseline commit. Private implementation and runtime behavior were not reviewed.
visual_boundary: Illustrations explain the documented input, transformation and output. Factory checkpoints are a conceptual delivery path, not a recording of work completed for a repository.
private_source_policy: Private project concepts may use only the names and roles already published in the public atlas at commit 549098d56def24511d7b941da31ce5c6875f3df9. No private repository source or data was read for this map.
